title: Aureline M5 supported-line defect ledger
description: Canonical per-domain defect ledger for the correction/backport line and the launch-bundle-currentness line. Names the defect entry, its named correction-line owner, the backport-decision SLA, whether the backport decision was recorded within that SLA, the bundle-currentness posture, and whether the launch bundle was re-audited so no backport rests on tribal memory instead of a documented correction packet and no shipping line ships a stale launch bundle without a currentness audit. Downstream release, help, support, shiproom, and program-governance surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's correction ownership and bundle-currentness posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
